summary: Introduces the .env.example configuration template with documented settings for Codeberg token, Ollama host/model, and poll interval. Also adds .gitignore to exclude .env files and a thorough README rewrite explaining the project's purpose, setup, token scopes, hot reload, and troubleshooting. No functional code changes — purely configuration and documentation.

items.description: All configuration values are well-documented with inline comments. Consider linking to the token generation page directly in the comment for easier onboarding.
